lines.en: {i}It’s time to get gamey, but not like the meat! Four orbs of power make mission complete!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是时候“野”起来了——不过不是肉变味的那种野！集齐四颗力量宝珠，任务即告完成！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Do you have what it takes to defeat the [[insert generic antagonist]? Test your skills in the Shiawase Group’s latest RPG-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你有本事打败[[在此插入通用反派]吗？在 Shiawase 集团最新的 RPG 里测试你的实力——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please be advised that Sensei-Quest is still in early access and all assets and aspects are subject to change.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请注意，《Sensei 大冒险》仍处于抢先体验阶段，所有素材与设定都可能更改。{/i}

lines.en: : Is the main antagonist a pizza?
{i}No. We just liked how the icon looked. It really fit the vibe we were going for. We might change it later.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不是。我们只是觉得那个图标好看。它特别契合我们想要营造的氛围。以后可能会改。{/i}

lines.en: : What is it with games and releasing in early access these days? Why can’t you just finish them first?
lines.zh: : 现在的游戏怎么都爱搞抢先体验？你们就不能先做完再发吗？

lines.en: {i}Because we need your money! Now run along and collect PREMIUM CURRENCY if you want to get to the end of the game!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为我们需要你的钱！现在快去收集高级货币吧，想打到游戏结局就得靠它！{/i}

lines.en: {i}There will be an option to buy this later. But you’re a beta-tester right now, so we’ve added PREMIUM CURRENCY as a drop from every standard enemy in the game.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}以后会开放购买选项。不过你现在是测试员，所以我们让游戏里每个普通敌人都会掉落高级货币。{/i}

lines.en: : But how am I supposed to defeat enemies if I don’t have any gear?
lines.zh: : 可我一点装备都没有，要怎么打敌人？

lines.en: {i}Oh! We took care of that as well!{/i}
: Was that last one really necessary?
lines.zh: : 最后那个真的有必要吗？

lines.en: {i}What’s wrong? DEPRESSION is a very powerful skill you can use to debuff your enemies by making them feel bad for you!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有什么问题？抑郁可是个非常强力的技能，能让敌人对你心生怜悯，从而给他们施加减益！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or at least that's what it will be. Right now, it doesn't do anything.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}至少以后会是这样。现在它什么效果都没有。{/i}

lines.en: : I wanna learn how to cast FIRE BALL.
{i}Then you better get out there and start earning PREMIUM CURRENCY!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那你最好赶紧出去赚高级货币！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, look! Here comes the tutorial NPC now!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦，快看！新手教程的 NPC 来了！{/i}

lines.en: : What’s that dripping out of your helmet, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，从你头盔里滴下来的是什么？

lines.en: : That is very interesting! Are you ready to learn how to play Sensei-Quest?
lines.zh: : 真有意思！你准备好学习怎么玩《Sensei 大冒险》了吗？

lines.en: : Do I even have a choice?
: Not if you ever want to see your family again!
lines.zh: : 要是你还想再见到家人，就没有！

lines.en: : The objective of Sensei-Quest is to track down the {b}Four Elemental Orbs of Power{/b} and combine them into an {b}Ancient Orb{/b} in order to summon the final boss!
lines.zh: : 《Sensei 大冒险》的目标是找到{b}四颗元素力量宝珠{/b}，把它们合成一颗{b}远古宝珠{/b}，以此召唤最终 boss！

lines.en: : Earth, Wind, Water, Fire. Got it.
: You said they’re elemental orbs, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不是说它们是元素宝珠吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but not {i}those{/i} elements. The elemental orbs {i}you{/i} need to collect are, {b}Plant, Worm, Fist,{/b} and {b}Red.{/b}
lines.zh: : 是啊，但不是{i}那几种{/i}元素。{i}你{/i}要收集的元素宝珠是：{b}植物{/b}、{b}蠕虫{/b}、{b}拳{/b}、还有{b}红色{/b}。

lines.en: : None of those things are elements.
lines.zh: : 这些没有一个是元素啊。

lines.en: : Not with that attitude, they’re not!
lines.zh: : 抱着这种态度，它们当然不是！

lines.en: : Oh! Also, my name is Meowri! I probably should have told you that earlier.
lines.zh: : 哦！对了，我叫 Meowri！我应该早点告诉你的。

lines.en: : It’s fine. You look kind of familiar, though.
lines.zh: : 没关系。不过你看着有点眼熟。

lines.en: : That isn’t very surprising! My design is based on the [[IDEAL FEMALE], so of course you’d remember if you ever encountered anyone who looks like me. But that’s not important right now!
lines.zh: : 这并不奇怪！我的设计原型是[[理想女性]，所以只要你见过长得像我的人，当然会记得。不过现在这不重要！

lines.en: : Sensei-Quest is an [[OPEN WORLD RPG], so you are free to explore wherever you like! We’re in the town of {b}Fuckladore{/b} right now, which is the main hub of the game.
lines.zh: : 《Sensei 大冒险》是一款[[开放世界 RPG]，所以你可以随心所欲地去任何地方探索！我们现在在 {b}Fuckladore{/b} 镇，那是游戏的主城。

lines.en: : Fuckladore is full of vendors and taverns! Or...will be full of vendors and taverns! Right now, there is only one of each.
lines.zh: : Fuckladore 到处都是商贩和酒馆！或者……以后会到处都是商贩和酒馆！现在这两样各只有一家。

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry about that. You can still feel free to browse those at your leisure, though!
lines.zh: : 是啊，抱歉啦。不过你还是可以随兴致去逛逛的！

lines.en: : The {b}MERCHANT{/b} sells weapons and armor you can use to better take down your enemies, while the {b}TAVERN{/b} sells powerful spells and abilities you can use to...also take down your enemies.
lines.zh: : {b}商人{/b}卖武器和护甲，能让你更轻松地干掉敌人；{b}酒馆{/b}则卖强力的法术和能力，用途是……同样干掉敌人。

lines.en: : Why does the tavern sell spells? Isn’t that supposed to be the kind of place that I pick up quests from or something like that?
lines.zh: : 酒馆为什么卖法术？那种地方不是应该用来接任务的吗？

lines.en: : Is it? None of our developers have ever played a video game before. We’re all just kind of guessing.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我们的开发者以前从来没玩过电子游戏。全都是靠猜的。

lines.en: : This is sounding less fun by the second.
lines.zh: : 听起来是越来越没意思了。

lines.en: : Just wait until you find out the combat mechanics lack any amount of depth and use the same text box system as visual novels!
lines.zh: : 等你发现战斗系统毫无深度、还用的是和视觉小说一样的文本框系统，你就知道了！

lines.en: : The game is super grindy too!
: Can I just exit out of your dialogue and go exploring now? I clearly have a lot of work to do.
lines.zh: : 我能退出你的对话去探险了吗？我显然有一大堆事要做。

lines.en: : Okay! If you want to explore on your own, I’ll let you.
lines.zh: : 好的！如果你想自己去探索，我不拦你。

lines.en: : Just come find me once you’ve collected all of the Orbs of Power and I’ll help you summon the final boss.
lines.zh: : 等你集齐所有力量宝珠来找我，我就帮你召唤最终 boss。

lines.en: : Cool. Thanks, Meowri. I can’t wait to unlock the first sex scene.
lines.zh: : 酷。谢了，Meowri。我等不及要解锁第一场色情场景了。

lines.en: : There aren’t any sex scenes in Sensei-Quest.
lines.zh: : 《Sensei 大冒险》里没有任何色情场景。

lines.en: {i}It’s time for you to save the world!{/i}
: I will be the hero this world needs.
lines.zh: : 我会成为这个世界所需要的英雄。

lines.en: : But where should I begin my adventure?
lines.zh: : 可是我该从哪里开始我的冒险呢？

lines.en: {i}This is the point of no return. Do you still wish to proceed?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}此乃不归之点。你仍要继续吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Wow, an actual helpful tip for once.
lines.zh: : 哇，总算有一条真正有用的提示了。

lines.en: {i}Do you wish to proceed or not?{/i}
: I have a few loose ends to tie up first...
lines.zh: : 我还有几件事要先收个尾……

lines.en: : Hey there! Welcome to the Traveler’s Tavern.
lines.zh: : 你好啊！欢迎来到旅人酒馆。

lines.en: : I haven’t seen you around here before. Are you new in town?
lines.zh: : 我以前没在这附近见过你。你是新来的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I just woke up here and now I need to collect a bunch of orbs or I will never see my family again. How is your day?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我刚在这儿醒来，现在得收集一堆宝珠，不然就再也见不到我的家人了。你今天过得怎么样？
: 哦，就那样吧。没什么可抱怨的。

lines.en: : Well, actually I can since none of the assets for my tavern have been added into Sensei-Quest yet and I’m kind of just standing around in an empty room waiting for an update.
lines.zh: : 嗯，其实还是有的——因为我这家酒馆的素材还没被加进《Sensei 大冒险》，我现在基本就是站在一间空屋子里等更新。

lines.en: : But I’ve got items! And quests!
lines.zh: : 不过我有道具！还有任务！

lines.en: : But the tutorial said you didn’t have quests and that you only sold abilities.
lines.zh: : 可教程说你没有任务，只卖技能。

lines.en: : Outdated tooltip, I guess. But it’s not like those things are ever helpful in the first place, right?
lines.zh: : 大概是过时的提示框吧。不过反正那些东西本来就没什么用，对吧？

lines.en: : Can I have {b}Fire Ball{/b} for free please?
lines.zh: : 能免费给我一个{b}火球术{/b}吗？

lines.en: : Nope! But I’d be willing to let it go for only 500 PREMIUM CURRENCY.
lines.zh: : 不行！不过只要 500 高级货币，我就愿意出手。

lines.en: : That’s the same exact price written on the board. I’m not getting a discount at all.
lines.zh: : 这跟牌子上写的价格一模一样。我根本没拿到折扣。

lines.en: : No discounts here, buddy. A girl’s gotta make a living after all.
lines.zh: : 这儿不打折，老兄。女孩子总得讨生活嘛。

lines.en: : Ughhhh this game is so user unfriendly. I hate having to work for things.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃，这游戏太不友好了。我讨厌非得靠努力才能得到东西。

lines.en: : Same here, man. You think I want to be spending all of my time just standing around like this? Heck no. I ain’t built for the NPC life. So just tell me what you want or drag your butt on outta here. Capiche?
lines.zh: : 我也是啊，兄弟。你以为我愿意把所有时间都花在这样干站着上？才怪。我天生不是当 NPC 的料。所以要么告诉我你要什么，要么就抬屁股滚出去。懂吗？

lines.en: : What can I get for you?
Right now, I have [pcur] PREMIUM CURRENCY.
lines.zh: 目前，我有 [pcur] 高级货币。

lines.en: What do I want to buy?
: Rumor has it that some big ole’ douchebag is holed up in the Sea of Stairs. And if my intel is correct, he might have one of those orbs you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 有传言说，有个大号混蛋躲在阶梯之海里。如果我的情报没错，他身上可能就有你要找的其中一颗宝珠。

lines.en: : How possible is it that your intel is incorrect?
lines.zh: : 你的情报出错的可能性有多大？

lines.en: : Did you just sell me a quest that only has a 50%% chance of giving me a reward?
lines.zh: : 你刚才是卖给我一个只有 50%% 几率给奖励的任务？

lines.en: : Yup! And there’s nothing you can do about it either since all sales are final.
lines.zh: : 没错！而且你也拿它没办法，因为概不退换。

lines.en: : I would like to speak to the manager.
: That’ll cost you another 5000 PREMIUM CURRENCY.
lines.zh: : 那要再收你 5000 高级货币。

lines.en: : Yes. Why do you hate me?
: I never hate the player. I hate the game.
lines.zh: : 我从不恨玩家。我恨的是这游戏。

lines.en: : Get it? Because we’re in a game right now.
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？因为我们现在就在游戏里。

lines.en: : I think I'll just try my luck without speaking to the manager.
lines.zh: : 我想我就不找经理了，碰碰运气吧。

lines.en: : One of my other customers just came in and told me something about an ancient being taking shelter somewhere in Bedlehem.
lines.zh: : 我另一个客人刚进来，跟我说有个远古存在正躲在床利恒的某个地方。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you had other customers.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还有别的客人。

lines.en: : Of course I have other customers. What would the point of a beta test be if only one person was testing the game?
lines.zh: : 我当然有别的客人。要是只有一个人测试，那还叫什么公测？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. How do I get to Bedlehem, though? I’ve never been there before.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。不过我要怎么去床利恒？我从来没去过。

lines.en: : Not many people have. It’s a super secret location that only a handful of us know how to reach. But seeing as you’ve purchased the quest, I guess I kind of have to tell you, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 去过的人不多。那是个超级隐秘的地点，只有我们少数几个人知道怎么去。不过既然你买了这个任务，我想我大概得告诉你了，对吧？

lines.en: : That would be greatly appreciated. I have a good feeling I’ll be able to find one of the elemental orbs there.
lines.zh: : 那就太感谢了。我有种预感，我能在那儿找到一颗元素宝珠。

lines.en: : Maybe! Only one way to find out, buddy!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！只有一种办法能知道，老兄！

lines.en: {i}You’re not sure how, but without any actual dialogue revealing the details of the location, you suddenly know how to get to Bedlehem!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你不知道怎么回事，但在没有任何对白交代地点细节的情况下，你突然就知道该怎么去床利恒了！{/i}

lines.en: : There’s this place not far from here where all of the strongest adventurers go to train called the Palace of the Fist.
lines.zh: : 离这儿不远有个地方，所有最强的冒险者都去那儿修行，叫做拳之宫殿。

lines.en: : And right now, the master of the palace is offering an orb of power to anyone who is able to defeat him.
lines.zh: : 而现在，宫殿的掌门宣布，任何能打败他的人都能得到一颗力量宝珠。

lines.en: : Taking him down will be no easy task, though. And even if you have the right build, you might have to try a bunch of different methods until something works.
lines.zh: : 不过要放倒他绝非易事。就算你的配点正确，也可能得试上好几种不同的方法，才能找到管用的那个。

lines.en: : If that is the price that must be paid for reuniting with my family, I will do it. I will bring this palace master to his knees.
lines.zh: : 如果这是与家人重逢必须付出的代价，我愿意。我会让这位掌门跪下。

lines.en: : Go for it, Sensei! I believe in you!
: I will put my wiener is his stupid mouth too.
lines.zh: : 我还要把我的香肠塞进他那张蠢嘴里。

lines.en: : Then I’ll wiggle it around and tell him to call me “daddy.”
lines.zh: : 然后我要在里面搅来搅去，让他叫我“爸爸”。

lines.en: : You’re being really weird about this, man.
lines.zh: : 你在这件事上真的很怪，老兄。

lines.en: : He better be ready for my cummy-wummies.
lines.zh: : 他最好准备好迎接我的精华液。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m gonna have to ask you to leave now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我现在得请你出去了。

lines.en: {i}You got kicked out of the store!{/i}
: That guy will never know what hit him once the penis comes out.
lines.zh: : 等我的鸡巴一掏出来，那家伙绝对不知道是什么打中了他。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to tell you this, but the {b}Unholy Cathedral{/b} is the most dangerous place east of Fucklador.
lines.zh: : 我肯定不用跟你说这个，不过{b}邪神圣堂{/b}是 Fucklador 以东最危险的地方。

lines.en: : What’s the most dangerous place to the west?
lines.zh: : 那以西最危险的地方是哪儿？

lines.en: : Please tell me there isn’t an orb there.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我那儿没有宝珠。

lines.en: : There might be! But yeah, for your sake, I hope there’s not.
lines.zh: : 可能有！不过看在你的份上，我也希望没有。

lines.en: : But anyway! If you want to try your luck against the {b}Red Twins,{/b} I’d head over there. It won’t be an easy fight, though. Most of my customers try to stay clear of that place by any means possible.
lines.zh: : 总之！如果你想去碰碰运气对付{b}红色双子{/b}，我就往那儿去。不过那不会是场轻松的战斗。我的大多数客人都会想尽办法离那地方远远的。

lines.en: : What happens to the ones who don’t?
lines.zh: : 那些没躲开的会怎么样？

lines.en: : Well, I wouldn’t still be selling this quest if any of them completed it, would I?
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是他们里有谁通关了，我也不会还在卖这个任务了，对吧？

lines.en: : Good point. Guess I’ll go see if I can take them down then.
lines.zh: : 有道理。那我大概得去看看能不能放倒她们了。

lines.en: : Okay! Just try not to die. I kind of need you to stay alive for reasons.
lines.zh: : 好的！尽量别死。我有点需要你活着，是有原因的。

lines.en: : You’ll find out in the sequel.
{i}Sensei has obtained the first piece of an ancient map!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 获得了古地图的第一块碎片！{/i}

lines.en: : Hell yeah. Now I can finally go treasure hunting.
lines.zh: : 太爽了。现在终于可以去寻宝了。

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do with this?
lines.zh: : 这东西我该拿来干什么？

lines.en: : Beats me. I just figured I could make a quick dime off of it.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。我只是觉得能靠它赚点快钱。

lines.en: I should try and find the rest of the map...
lines.zh: 我得想办法找到地图的其余部分……

lines.en: : What is this? This is not sex.
lines.zh: : 这是什么？这根本不是性。

lines.en: : Of course it’s not sex. Did you seriously think you were going to be able to just buy your way into my pants?
lines.zh: : 当然不是性。你真以为花点钱就能钻进我的裤子里？

lines.en: : The tutorial straight up told you there wasn’t any sex in this game. What the hell were you thinking? How long did you have to grind to even get this much PREMIUM CURRENCY?
lines.zh: : 教程明明白白告诉你这游戏里没有性。你到底在想什么？你刷了多久才攒到这么多高级货币？

lines.en: : A long time. I am so tired. Please give sex now.
lines.zh: : 很久。我累坏了。现在请给我性。

lines.en: : Not that kind of girl, pal. But that coupon will get you 10%% off at Tojo Ramen once you get out of here!
lines.zh: : 我不是那种女孩，朋友。不过等你出去后，这张优惠券能让你在 Tojo 拉面享 10%% 折扣！

lines.en: : I’d rather take 10%% of your clothes off.
lines.zh: : 我更想让你脱掉 10%% 的衣服。

lines.en: : Do you...want my tie as a consolation prize?
lines.zh: : 你……想要我的领带当安慰奖吗？

lines.en: : Can I have your underwear instead?
: Please get out of my store.
{i}You got kicked out of the store!{/i}
: Hey there, nyaa! Welcome to the shop, nyaa! First time in, nyaa?
lines.zh: : 你好呀，喵！欢迎光临本店，喵！第一次来吗，喵？

lines.en: : Are you going to do that at the end of every sentence?
lines.zh: : 你打算每句话结尾都加这个吗？

lines.en: : Would you like me to stop, nyaa?
: Praise the lord. If I had to do that one more time, I was probably going to claw my eyes out. So thanks to you, I won’t go blind!
lines.zh: : 赞美主。要是再多说一次，我大概就要把自己的眼睛挠出来了。所以多亏了你，我不会瞎掉了！

lines.en: : As the hero who will save the world, I am happy to be of service. Now tell me, merchant — what is it you sell here?
lines.zh: : 作为将要拯救世界的英雄，我很乐意效劳。那么告诉我，商人——你这儿卖些什么？

lines.en: : Can you not read the graphic to my left? Did the developers forget to code it in or something?
lines.zh: : 我左边那块图你看不懂吗？难道开发者忘了把它写进代码里？

lines.en: : I can read it. I just wasn’t sure if that would be meta-gaming or if you had to verbally tell me before I could conceive those words in-universe.
lines.zh: : 我看得懂。我只是不确定那算不算元游戏，还是说必须你亲口告诉我，我才能在游戏世界里理解那些字。

lines.en: : Nope. Just look at the board, tell me what you want, then fork over the dough.
lines.zh: : 不用。看着牌子，告诉我你要什么，然后掏钱。

lines.en: : Why is everything so expensive here?
lines.zh: : 这里的东西怎么都这么贵？

lines.en: : Or complain too. That’s fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者也可以抱怨。反正也无所谓。

lines.en: : You’re charging 800 PREMIUM CURRENCY for a bucket.
lines.zh: : 一个桶你居然要价 800 高级货币。

lines.en: : It’s a good bucket. What do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 那可是个好桶。你还想让我怎样？

lines.en: : For what? What do you even need that for?
lines.zh: : 用来干嘛？你要那玩意儿做什么？

lines.en: : I have no idea. I just got here. Everything is so fresh and new to me.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。我才刚到这儿。对我来说一切都很新鲜陌生。

lines.en: : Well, it’ll all make sense in due time why my prices seem a little high. But even if it doesn’t, I don’t have any competition! And if you’re going to advance, you’re going to {i}have{/i} to buy this stuff sooner or later.
lines.zh: : 嗯，到时候你就会明白我的价格为什么显得偏高了。就算不明白也没关系——我可没有竞争对手！而且你要想推进剧情，早晚{i}都得{/i}买这些东西。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that, roadside merchant.
lines.zh: : 那我们就走着瞧吧，路边商人。

lines.en: : So! Anything tickle your fancy right now? Or do you want to shop around for a bit? And by “a bit” I mean forever. Because, again, I’m the only girl with wares like these.
lines.zh: : 那么！现在有什么看得上眼的吗？还是你想再逛逛？我说的“再逛逛”是指永远。因为，再说一遍，我是唯一一个卖这些货的女孩。

lines.en: : What can I get for you?
Right now, I have [pcur] PREMIUM CURRENCY.
lines.zh: 目前，我有 [pcur] 高级货币。

lines.en: What do I want to buy?
: Not so high and mighty now, are you?
lines.zh: : 现在不那么趾高气昂了吧？

lines.en: : I can’t believe I just paid 800 PREMIUM CURRENCY for a bucket.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信我刚花 800 高级货币买了个桶。

lines.en: : I can. It’s called capitalism, buddy. Supply and demand. There are no other buckets in Fucklador.
lines.zh: : 我信。这叫资本主义，老兄。供求关系。Fucklador 可没有别的桶。

lines.en: : Well, at least now you’ve got a bucket to catch some of it!
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少现在你有个桶可以接住一些了！

lines.en: {i}Sensei has obtained the second piece of an ancient map!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 获得了古地图的第二块碎片！{/i}

lines.en: : Hell yeah. Now I can finally go treasure hunting.
lines.zh: : 太爽了。现在终于可以去寻宝了。

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do with this?
lines.zh: : 这东西我该拿来干什么？

lines.en: : Beats me. I just figured I could make a quick dime off of it.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。我只是觉得能靠它赚点快钱。

lines.en: I should try and find the rest of the map...
lines.zh: 我得想办法找到地图的其余部分……

lines.en: {i}A new profile outfit for Kaori has been unlocked!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}已解锁 Kaori 的新档案服装！{/i}

lines.en: {i}A new profile outfit for Nao-chan has been unlocked!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}已解锁 Nao 酱的新档案服装！{/i}

lines.en: : Is there a problem, dear customer?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗，亲爱的客人？

lines.en: : I think there might be a printing error on your menu. This is not what I attempted to purchase.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的菜单可能有印刷错误。这不是我想买的东西。

lines.en: I hold the stick out so she can see that it’s a stick and not sex.
lines.zh: 我把棍子举起来，好让她看清楚这是根棍子，而不是性。

lines.en: : That seems like a quality piece of wood to me! May I ask what you were attempting to buy?
lines.zh: : 在我看来这可是块上好的木头！我能请问您原本想买什么吗？

lines.en: : Well, how am I supposed to help if I don’t know what the error is?
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果我不知道出了什么错，要怎么帮您呢？

lines.en: : Can’t you just look at my receipt?
lines.zh: : 你就不能看看我的收据吗？

lines.en: : Then no, I can’t help you.
lines.zh: : 那就没办法了，我帮不了您。

lines.en: : But if you’re looking to sell that neat stick you’ve got there, I can give you...10 PREMIUM CURRENCY for it!
lines.zh: : 不过如果您想出手手上那根漂亮的棍子，我可以出……10 高级货币！

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll give you 15. But that’s my final offer.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我出 15。但这是最终报价了。

lines.en: {i}The Fields of Despair sprawl out for miles before you! Just look at how sad everything is!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}绝望平原在你面前绵延数英里！看看这一切有多悲伤吧！{/i}

lines.en: : This doesn’t look sad at all.
lines.zh: : 这看起来一点都不悲伤啊。

lines.en: {i}Nuh-uh. There’s some other stuff too. Just look at that guy in the suit back there. And- oh! I see a snail!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}才不是。还有别的东西呢。看看后面那个穿西装的家伙。还有——哦！我看到一只蜗牛！{/i}

lines.en: : I guess that guy back there does look kind of sad now that you mention it.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，后面那家伙看起来确实有点悲伤。

lines.en: {i}Told you! But anyway! The Fields of Despair are where you can grind for PREMIUM CURRENCY!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我就说吧！总之！绝望平原就是你刷高级货币的地方！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Each monster has its own weakness and monetary value!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}每只怪物都有自己的弱点和货币价值！{/i}

lines.en: {i}In the final version of the game, these monsters will drop SUBPREMIUM CURRENCY which can be exchanged for PREMIUM CURRENCY at an exchange rate of 2:1 or RAINBOW COINS at 4:1!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在游戏的最终版本中，这些怪物会掉落次级高级货币，可按 2:1 的汇率兑换成高级货币，或按 4:1 兑换成彩虹币！{/i}

lines.en: {i}SUBPREMIUM CURRENCY can also be purchased with real money.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}次级高级货币也可以用真钱购买。{/i}

lines.en: : Hold on, what the fuck are RAINBOW COINS?
lines.zh: : 等等，彩虹币到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: {i}A higher tier of PREMIUM CURRENCY that can be purchased in special bundles with RAINBOW QUARTZ!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是高级货币的更高阶形态，可以用彩虹石英在特惠礼包中购买！{/i}

lines.en: {i}But we love you! And we definitely mean you! Not just your wallet!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但我们爱你！我们指的绝对是你！不只是你的钱包！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Now, go! Grind! Earn your PREMIUM CURRENCY!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在，去吧！去刷！去赚你的高级货币！{/i}

lines.en: Looks like I’m back here again...
{i}You approach the man wearing a suit. His name is Kenji. He does not belong here.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你走向那个穿西装的男人。他叫 Kenji。他不属于这里。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He gazes out at the mountains, thinking back to the days when he would visit his grandparents in the countryside of Gifu. It all seems so distant now. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}他望向远山，回想起在岐阜乡下探望祖父母的日子。如今一切都显得那么遥远。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Kenji had been off the clock for several hours but, for some reason, he decided to stop here today instead of returning to his wife.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kenji 已经下班好几个小时了，可不知为何，他今天选择在这里驻足，而不是回到妻子身边。{/i}

lines.en: {i}They had been fighting lately. Their marriage hadn’t been the same since he’d learned of her affair. But Kenji was spineless and couldn’t find the words to say to try and mend the rift.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他们最近一直在吵架。自从他得知她的外遇之后，他们的婚姻就变了味。可 Kenji 是个没骨气的人，找不到合适的话去修补那道裂痕。{/i}

lines.en: {i}His eyes hone in on a cardinal — his daughter’s favorite bird. She had passed away from a lengthy battle with leukemia just a few years ago. He visited her grave every Wednesday.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他的目光锁定在一只北美红雀上——那是他女儿最爱的鸟。几年前，她与白血病长期抗争后离世。他每周三都去给她扫墓。{/i}

lines.en: : Why is there so much background information on this enemy mob?
lines.zh: : 为什么这个小怪会有这么多背景设定？

lines.en: {i}Kenji’s favorite number was nine. When he was younger, he had dreams of becoming a figure skater. But it was a dream that would be shattered along with his kneecap senior year of high school.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kenji 最喜欢的数字是九。他年轻时曾梦想成为一名花样滑冰选手。但那个梦想在高三那年和他的膝盖骨一起碎掉了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He daydreams of the river — of dipping his toes in and feeling like a child again. And he remembers the games he would play with his brothers as the water washed over their feet.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他出神地想起那条河——想起把脚趾探进水里、重新变回孩子的感觉。他想起和兄弟们在溪水漫过脚背时玩过的游戏。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He hadn’t seen any of them in years now either, but it wasn’t as if his relationship with them was strained. He was just never good at facing the past — and that’s all they were now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他也已经好几年没见过他们中的任何一个了，不过他和他们的关系倒也说不上紧张。他只是从来都不善于面对过去——而他们如今也只剩“过去”了。{/i}

lines.en: : Why must we fight at all?
: Oh, god. You gave him voice lines?
lines.zh: : 哦，天啊。你们连配音台词都给他写了？

lines.en: : No matter how many times I fall, I’ll come right back. I think it’s...some kind of metaphor.
lines.zh: : 无论我倒下多少次，都会立刻重新站起。我觉得这……是某种隐喻。

lines.en: : Tell me, young man...what do you believe the meaning of life is?
lines.zh: : 告诉我，年轻人……你认为生命的意义是什么？

lines.en: : Are we put here to find happiness? Or are we only here to die?
lines.zh: : 我们被放到这世上，是为了寻找幸福吗？还是仅仅为了死去？

lines.en: : Maybe there’s no reason at all now that I think about it. Maybe this is all just the result of some fortunate coincidence. And maybe these experiences and lives we lead will be just as fleeting as our fading youth.
lines.zh: : 现在想想，也许根本就没有什么理由。也许这一切不过是某个幸运巧合的结果。也许我们经历的这些人生，会像我们消逝的青春一样转瞬即逝。

lines.en: : You seek the {b}Four Orbs of Power{/b}, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在寻找{b}四颗力量宝珠{/b}，对吧？

lines.en: : Ha...I remember when I set off on my journey as well.
lines.zh: : 哈……我也记得自己踏上旅程的时候。

lines.en: : I’d just registered at the Adventurer’s Guild...my eyes were still so bright and full of hope back then.
lines.zh: : 我刚在冒险者公会登记完……那时候我的眼睛还是那么明亮，充满希望。

lines.en: : But now, I don’t even have eyes.
lines.zh: : 可现在，我连眼睛都没有了。

lines.en: : My...time surely does fly, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我……的时光确实飞逝啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : Tell me...when you find the {b}Four Orbs of Power...{/b}what do you intend to do? And if your answer is “find my family” or anything along those lines, let me reassure you...they’re safe and sound.
lines.zh: : 告诉我……当你找到{b}四颗力量宝珠{/b}时……你打算做什么？如果你的答案是“找我的家人”或类似的话，让我先安你的心……他们安然无恙。

lines.en: : They were never in any danger at all. That’s just a lie the game masters tell us to push us forward. To buy more PREMIUM CURRENCY out of fear that they’ll be harmed. But it’s all just manipulation.
lines.zh: : 他们从来就没有陷入过任何危险。那不过是游戏管理员用来推着我们往前走的谎言。好让我们出于怕他们受害的恐惧，去购买更多高级货币。可这一切都只是操纵。

lines.en: : We exist to line their pockets...they don’t even think of us as human.
lines.zh: : 我们存在，只是为了让他们的钱袋鼓起来……他们甚至不把我们当人看。

lines.en: : But you’re different...you still have a chance. {i}You{/i} can be the one to break us out of this cycle.
lines.zh: : 但你不一样……你还有机会。{i}你{/i}可以成为那个带我们打破这个循环的人。

lines.en: : So...what do you say, young man? Do you have what it takes to save us?
lines.zh: : 所以……你怎么说，年轻人？你有本事拯救我们吗？

lines.en: : Where will your journey lead you from here?
lines.zh: : 从这里出发，你的旅程会把你带向何方？

lines.en: {i}Kenji plunges down the cliff! His body collides with jagged rocks along the way and you can see them tear him open in various places.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kenji 坠下悬崖！他的身体一路撞上嶙峋的岩石，你能看见岩石在多处将他撕裂开来。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Countless memories topple down with him. Visions of his daughter. Conversations at the dinner table with his wife. Family dinners. Soccer games. It’s all gone now. And it’s all your fault.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}数不清的记忆随他一同坠落。女儿的影像。和妻子在餐桌上的对话。家庭聚餐。足球赛。现在全都没了。而这一切都是你的错。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You also don’t collect any PREMIUM CURRENCY as you would need to climb to the bottom of the cliff to loot his body.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你也没能拿到任何高级货币，因为要搜刮他的尸体，你得先爬到悬崖底下。{/i}

lines.en: : Guess I’ll just keep grinding then...

lines.zh: {i}请注意——《Sensei 大冒险》仍处于抢先体验阶段！你就当他现在没有模型好了！{/i}

lines.en: : You’ve been gone a long time, Sensei. Many things have happened. And {i}I{/i} am the ruler of this realm now.

lines.en: : Oh, so like none of the human girls?

lines.en: : I had a threesome with one of the dorms before everyone died, though.

lines.en: : I’m not really sure. I haven’t grown any eyes yet. Just a bunch of these Bolwig organ things. Which really sucks because it makes me think I’m going to be a maggot forever.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。我还没长出眼睛。只长了一堆叫什么 Bolwig 器官的东西。这可真糟心，因为它让我觉得自己要当一辈子蛆虫了。

lines.en: : Is that why you’re so unfriendly now?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在才这么不友善？

lines.en: : That makes sense. It’s really good to see you, though. You’ve grown a lot.
lines.zh: : 这倒说得通。不过能见到你真好。你长大了不少。

lines.en: : Thanks, man. You look good too.

lines.en: : So, can I have the Orb of Presumably Worm or do I actually have to fight you for it?
lines.zh: : 那么，我能直接拿走那颗大概是蠕虫的宝珠，还是非得跟你打一架？

lines.en: : You’ve gotta fight me for it. Sorry, dude. Honest truth is I’ve had it ever since A Life of Prizes. It’s what gives me the ability to speak. And I’ve got a girlfriend now. I won’t let you steal my voice.
lines.zh: : 你得跟我打才行。抱歉啊，老兄。说实话，从《A Life of Prizes》那会儿起它就一直在我身上。是它让我能说话。而且我现在有女朋友了。我不会让你偷走我的声音。

lines.en: : Then...it looks like the time has come...

lines.en: : For me to be Unfriendly Sensei!

lines.en: : I sure hope that’s the case. Because the pathetic display of combat skills you showed off in our last bout was nothing short of child’s play.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此。因为上一回合你那套可悲的战斗技巧，简直幼稚得像小孩子过家家。

lines.en: : Well, you don’t have to be a dick about it. I’m trying really hard. This puzzle is weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你也不必这么刻薄。我已经很努力了。这个谜题很怪。

lines.en: : Not as weird as the hairy frog.
lines.zh: : 再怪也怪不过那只多毛的青蛙。

lines.en: : The one that sneaks in the night — floating by like a log on a larger log.
lines.zh: : 那个在夜里潜行的家伙——像一根木头漂在更大的木头上。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m just going to fight you now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我现在直接开打了。

lines.en: : Well, well, well...look who finally decided to return home.
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀……看看是谁终于决定回家了。

lines.en: : You know, I knew from the moment I first encountered you that you were going to be a boss I’d have to defeat for a key item in a presumably delusional RPG one day.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，从第一次遇见你的那一刻起，我就知道你总有一天会成为我在某款大概是妄想出来的 RPG 里、为了关键道具而必须打败的 boss。

lines.en: : I highly doubt the accuracy of that statement. But I welcome you back nonetheless as I’ve been eagerly awaiting the day we cross swords.
lines.zh: : 我很怀疑这话的真实性。不过还是欢迎你回来——毕竟我一直在热切盼望着我们交剑的那一天。

lines.en: : Are we even allowed to use swords in karate?
lines.zh: : 空手道比赛里允许用剑吗？

lines.en: : It was merely a figure of speech — another way to say the cicada always catches its breakfast on Fish Day.
lines.zh: : 那不过是个比喻——换句话说，就是蝉总能在鱼日捕到它的早餐。

lines.en: : Karate is no different from a blade of grass that never found its way home. Or a smile that has just learned how to frown.
lines.zh: : 空手道与一棵永远找不到归途的草叶并无二致。或者说，是一张刚刚学会皱眉的笑脸。

lines.en: : Oh, I get it. You’re supposed to be wise or something, but the writer of this game isn’t very good.
lines.zh: : 哦，我懂了。你应该是要显得很睿智什么的，可惜这游戏的主笔水平不太行。

lines.en: : Or I have merely transcended human knowledge and can now speak on a level that only {b}Enlightened Ones{/b} can understand.
lines.zh: : 又或者，我只是已经超越了人类的知识，如今能用只有{b}觉醒者{/b}才能听懂的语言说话。

lines.en: : I want to doubt you, but that bolded text is making me think twice.
lines.zh: : 我想怀疑你，可那行加粗的字让我又犹豫了。

lines.en: : You stand no chance against me, Sensei. But seeing as this is an open competition, I will not refuse your challenge. But also know that I will not hold back.
lines.zh: : 你毫无胜算，Sensei。不过既然这是公开比试，我不会拒绝你的挑战。但你要知道，我不会手下留情。

lines.en: {i}Random Karate Person takes a step forward! But the model doesn’t move. Just pretend.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}随机空手道人向前迈了一步！但模型并没有动。你假装一下就好。{/i}

lines.en: : Today will be the first day of the rest of your life...and the last day of your third week in Cancun!
lines.zh: : 今天将是你余生的第一天……也是你在坎昆第三周的最后一天！
{i}Sensei 险之又险地闪开了攻击！{/i}

lines.en: : Is that all you’ve got, weakling?
lines.zh: : 你就只有这点本事吗，弱者？

lines.en: : Your fists are just so...full of fist-energy...
lines.zh: : 你的拳头真是……充满了拳之能量……

lines.en: : Like the hummingbird’s belt, I {i}am{/i} the Wheel of Fortune.
lines.zh: : 如蜂鸟的腰带一般，我即{i}是{/i}命运之轮。

lines.en: {i}You somehow manage to respawn in Fucklador.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你不知怎么在 Fucklador 复活了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Your hospital bill will be sent to you later.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你的医药费账单稍后会寄给你。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Random Karate Person dodges the attack with ease!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}随机空手道人轻松闪避了攻击！{/i}

lines.en: : Years of training my fists and feet — like a meadow swallowing goldfish.
lines.zh: : 长年累月修炼我的拳与脚——如草原吞下金鱼。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...while you were training your fists and feet, I was studying the blade!
lines.zh: : 是吗，嗯……你练拳脚的时候，我可是在练剑！

lines.en: : YOU ACTUALLY USED A FUCKING SWORD?! ARE YOU INSANE?!
lines.zh: : 你还真他妈用了把剑？！你疯了吗？！

lines.en: : YOU TOLD ME WE WERE GOING TO CROSS THEM AND YOU DIDN’T EVEN BRING ONE!
lines.zh: : 你明明说我们要"交剑"的，结果你自己连一把都没带！

lines.en: : I TOLD YOU IT WAS A FIGURE OF SPEECH, IDIOT! THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE A FAIR FIGHT! HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO-
lines.zh: : 我说了那只是个比喻，白痴！这本来该是一场公平的战斗！你要我怎么——

lines.en: {i}Sensei swings the Sword of Hope again!{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Sensei 把随机空手道人斩首了！{/i}

lines.en: : At least {i}this{/i} purchase is giving me a better return on my investment than my Boots of Ass.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}这{/i}笔消费给我的投资回报，比我那双"臀部之靴"高多了。

lines.en: {i}Sensei swings his sword once more, cleaning the blood off his blade as he reaches down and plucks the {b}Orb of Fist{/b} from Random Karate Person’s pocket!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 又一次挥剑，拭去刀刃上的血迹，同时俯身从随机空手道人的口袋里掏出了拳之宝珠！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sensei has obtained the Orb of Fist!{/i}
: I’m going to fist so many girls when I get home.
lines.zh: : 等我回家，我要用拳头和好多女孩干个痛快。

lines.en: {i}Little did he know, it would take a lot more than an Orb of Power to get his fist inside some of the girls he hangs around.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他并不知道，想让他的拳头伸进他身边某些女孩的体内，光靠一颗力量宝珠可远远不够。{/i}

lines.en: : First rule of karate — fight yellow with yellow!
lines.zh: : 空手道第一法则——以黄制黄！

lines.en: {i}Sensei’s Banana Blast is empowered by his cool dialogue!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 的香蕉爆击因他帅气的台词而威力大增！{/i}

lines.en: : Never underestimate the effect potassium can have on one’s body.
lines.zh: : 永远别低估钾元素对人体的作用。

lines.en: : Your words ring true — like the bell that summons the great frog. Or a leaf, blowing carelessly through the halls of a pet store.
lines.zh: : 你的话听起来很有道理——就像召唤巨蛙的钟声。又像一片叶子，漫不经心地吹过宠物店的走廊。

lines.en: : Your pitiful tricks won’t work more than once, though. Like a missing platypus, you lack the technique to make the trees lose sight of the bugs that live beneath them.
lines.zh: : 不过你那些可悲的把戏只能用一次。就像一只失踪的鸭嘴兽，你缺乏让树木看不见栖身其下之虫的技巧。

lines.en: : Also, you have the rules of karate wrong.
lines.zh: : 还有，你把空手道的规矩记错了。

lines.en: : I do? What’s the actual first rule then?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那真正的第一条规矩是什么？

lines.en: : It begins and ends with respect!
lines.zh: : 一切始于尊重，也终于尊重！

lines.en: {i}Random Karate Person attacks with Fist of Polaris!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}随机空手道人使出北极星之拳！{/i}

lines.en: : That wasn’t respectful at all! In fact, you’ve been disrespecting me pretty much this whole time!
lines.zh: : 那可一点都不尊重！事实上，你从头到尾都在羞辱我！

lines.en: : Rules are little more than wet socks in summer!
lines.zh: : 规矩不过是夏天里的一双湿袜子！

lines.en: {i}Random Karate Person stands there and lets it happen!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}随机空手道人站在那里任由它发生！{/i}

lines.en: : Thank you for taking the time to wash me. It is important to practice personal hygiene, especially after working up a sweat.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你花时间给我清洗。注重个人卫生很重要，尤其是在出一身汗之后。

lines.en: : This is supposed to be an attack. You’re not supposed to enjoy it.
lines.zh: : 这本来该是一次攻击。你不该享受的。

lines.en: : I see that, all these years later, you still don’t know the first thing of martial arts.
lines.zh: : 看来这么多年过去了，你对武术还是一窍不通。

lines.en: : Sure I do. Didn’t you see what I did with those bananas earlier?
lines.zh: : 我懂啊。你没看见我刚才用那些香蕉干了什么吗？

lines.en: : I did. But if your idea of an “attack” is to gingerly rub sanitizing solution all over my muscular body, I believe there is a disconnect between you and the ideas of true strength.
lines.zh: : 看见了。不过如果你所谓的"攻击"就是小心翼翼地把消毒液抹遍我强健的身躯，那我认为你和真正的力量之道之间存在着断层。

lines.en: : Gross, is that really what I’ve been doing this whole time? Without any attack animations, I kind of figured it was just a beam or something.
lines.zh: : 恶心，这段时间我一直在干的原来是这个？没有攻击动画，我还以为那就是一道光束什么的。

lines.en: : A beam is just some sort of ray.
: That...That one’s accurate, yeah. That’s what a beam is.
lines.zh: : 这……这句倒是没错，是啊。光束就是那个意思。

lines.en: : And a ray is nothing more than a deer without its day.
lines.zh: : 而射线不过是一只没有属于自己日子的鹿。

lines.en: {i}Sensei dodges the attack thanks to his Boots of Forgiveness — which have finally decided to work!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 靠宽恕之靴闪开了攻击——它终于肯发挥作用了！{/i}

lines.en: : How strange. No one has ever dodged that attack before. How did you do it?
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。从来没人躲开过这一招。你是怎么做到的？

lines.en: : An adventurer never reveals his secrets, Random Karate Person.
lines.zh: : 冒险者从不泄露自己的秘密，随机空手道人。

lines.en: : You bought the Boots of Forgiveness, didn’t you?
: Because {i}I’m{/i} the one who made them.
: This is a plot twist I was both not expecting and don’t fully understand.
lines.zh: : 这剧情反转既出乎我的意料，我也没完全理解。

lines.en: : Ew! What? I’m wearing boots made with human flesh?
lines.zh: : 呕！什么？我脚上穿的是用人肉做的靴子？

lines.en: : Just the extra flesh from my ass.
lines.zh: : 只是我屁股上多出来的那点肉。

lines.en: : Ass boots...{i}of forgiveness.{/i} And I {i}forgive{/i} you for purchasing them as they were stolen from me years ago by a former pupil of mine.
lines.zh: : 屁股靴……{i}宽恕之靴{/i}。我{i}原谅{/i}你买下它们，因为那是我多年前被一个旧日弟子偷走的。

lines.en: : So, like...how exactly do these boots allow me to dodge your-
lines.zh: : 那么，比如……这双靴子到底是怎么让我躲开你的——

lines.en: {i}Random Karate Person attacks with Fist of Polaris!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}随机空手道人使出北极星之拳！{/i}

lines.en: : The boots can read my mind. But I am severing my mental connection with them now. Your tricks are now as useless as a monkey wrench in a casserole.
lines.zh: : 那双靴子能读出我的心思。不过我现在要切断和它们的感应了。你的把戏如今就像砂锅里的活动扳手一样没用了。

lines.en: : I can’t believe I’m still wearing these...
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信我还穿着这玩意儿……

lines.en: {i}Random Karate Person attacks with Fist of Polaris! It breaks through Sensei’s defense!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}随机空手道人使出北极星之拳！它突破了 Sensei 的防御！{/i}

lines.en: : Thank you for joining us once more in the Unholy Cathedral. My name is [[REDACTED] and I am joined by Moyo Makinamo and Akira Arakawa for another installment of Untitled Ass Kicking.
lines.zh: : 感谢各位再次来到邪神圣堂收看本期节目。我叫[[已编辑]，与我同台的还有 Moyo Makinamo 和 Akira Arakawa，这是《无题·暴揍》的又一集。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, {i}yours{/i} is the ass that will be kicked this time! I’ve figured out your weakness, Red Twins.
lines.zh: : 可惜这次要被踢的屁股是{i}你们的{/i}！我已经看穿你们的弱点了，红色双子。

lines.en: : Is such a thing even possible when you’ve yet to fully discern your own?
lines.zh: : 在你连自己的弱点都还没完全看透的时候，这可能吗？

lines.en: : I guess there’s only one way to find out!
lines.zh: : 我想只有一种办法能知道！

lines.en: : Oh god, you two are here as well?
lines.zh: : 天啊，你们两个也在这儿？

lines.en: : Perhaps we are, perhaps we aren’t. There are plenty of ways for us to blend in, Akira. Plenty of ways to fit into places we do not belong.
lines.zh: : 也许在，也许不在。我们有很多办法融入其中，Akira。有很多办法挤进我们本不属于的地方。

lines.en: : Could the same not be said for you, though? Wandering around with dinner on your head like you’re some sort of hero when we all know you’re anything but.
lines.zh: : 不过，你又何尝不是如此？顶着晚饭在头顶到处晃悠，活像什么英雄——可我们都知道你跟英雄八竿子打不着。

lines.en: : Who are “they?” The ones who tend the garden? Dust the cobwebs off of tombstones? Your family is no more. And at this rate, you are sure to join them.
lines.zh: : "他们"是谁？是那些打理花园的人？是那些拂去墓碑上蛛网的人？你的家人早已不复存在。照这个势头，你注定要去与他们作伴。

lines.en: : I will defeat both of you and bring honor back to the name Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 我会打败你们两个，为重振荒川之名。

lines.en: : Honor never left {i}you.{/i} You’re the one who left it behind. And now that it’s sprouted legs and caught up with you...you’re afraid.
lines.zh: : 荣誉从未离开过{i}你{/i}。是你自己把它丢下了。而如今它长了腿追上你……你害怕了。

lines.en: : The only thing {i}I’m{/i} afraid of is you making me wear that dress.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}唯一怕的，就是你们逼我穿上那条裙子。

lines.en: : Is that you hinting at how you’d like to wear the dress? It’d be quite random otherwise.
lines.zh: : 你这是在暗示你想穿那条裙子？不然这话也太突兀了。

lines.en: : Pfft. Absolutely not. Even if it’s kind of cold in here and I still haven’t found or equipped any armor.
lines.zh: : 切。绝对不是。就算这儿有点冷，而我又还没找到、也没装备任何护甲。

lines.en: : Does that actually mean something or is she just yelling?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思，还是她只是在乱吼？
: 她在说……{i}去死的时候到了{/i}。

lines.en: {i}Sensei collapses to the ground, unable to breathe.{/i}
{i}As the light fades from his eyes, he curses Fred.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}当光芒从他眼中褪去时，他诅咒着 Fred。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred merely tips his hat in response...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 只是抬了抬帽子作为回应……{/i}

lines.en: {i}You somehow manage to respawn in Fucklador.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你不知怎么在 Fucklador 复活了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred is certainly a force to be reckoned with.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 无疑是个不可小觑的对手。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred picks himself up off the ground and dusts his clothes off before tipping his hat at you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 从地上爬起来，拍掉衣服上的灰尘，然后朝你抬了抬帽子。{/i}

lines.en: {b}{size=+20}YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU’VE DONE.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+20}你会为你的所作所为付出代价{/size}{/b}。

lines.en: {i}But why did it make a slapping noise?...{/i}
{i}Fred picks himself up off the ground, also confused by this, and dusts his clothes off before tipping his hat at you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 从地上爬起来，也同样对此感到困惑，拍掉衣服上的灰尘，然后朝你抬了抬帽子。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He’s starting to feel a little upset about all of these attacks...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他开始对这些攻击有点不高兴了……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred opens his mouth and swallows the venom!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 张开嘴，把毒液吞了下去！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred picks himself up off the ground, swipes away a few bananas, and dusts his clothes off before tipping his hat at you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 从地上爬起来，拨开几根香蕉，拍掉衣服上的灰尘，然后朝你抬了抬帽子。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Both he and Fred are so clean now!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他和 Fred 现在都好干净！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred tips his hat, as if to say thanks.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 抬了抬帽子，像是在道谢。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred reaches down to pick a coin off the ground, accidentally dodging the attack in the process!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Fred 弯腰去捡地上的一枚硬币，顺带不小心躲开了这次攻击！{/i}

lines.en: {i}He thanks you for the oil with a polite tip of his hat.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他礼貌地抬了抬帽子，感谢你的油。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fred doesn’t want a massage right now...{/i}
